seoTitle: Square Footage Calculator for Rectangles, Triangles, Circles and More
metaDescription: Calculate the area and perimeter of common shapes in feet, inches, metres, centimetres or yards, and see square feet, square metres and square yards.
intro: Measure a room, lot or surface and get the area in the unit you need.
why:
Pick a shape (rectangle, triangle, circle, trapezoid, ellipse or L-shape) and enter its dimensions; the page returns the area and perimeter in your unit and converts to square feet, square metres and square yards. The labels explain what each of A to D means for the chosen shape.

For flooring, paint or tiles add 5 to 10% for waste and cuts, and measure irregular rooms by splitting them into simple shapes.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Enter the dimensions A to D as described.
Add a waste allowance when buying materials.

faq.q: How do I measure an L-shaped room?
faq.a: Use the L-shape option: the bounding rectangle minus the cut-out corner.

faq.q: What is the formula for a circle?
Is the perimeter of an ellipse exact?

faq.a: No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
